quote.author: Michael Scotto
quote.text: The Utah Jazz will decline their team option on Isaiah Collier worth $4.99 million for the 2027-28 season, sources told HoopsHype. Collier has averaged 9.9 points, 6.6 assists, 3.0 rebounds, and 1.0 steals in three seasons. He’ll be a coveted unrestricted free agent.
